job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Prompt Engineer with 2 to 5 years of experience to craft and optimize the prompts behind our digital workers. The ideal candidate will have expertise in Python, NLP, and LLMs.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop innovative prompts to enhance the performance of our digital workers.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines using Python and other relevant technologies.


Apply NLP techniques to analyze and interpret complex data sets.


Optimize LLMs for improved performance and efficiency.


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and develop tailored solutions.




Job Requirements




Strong proficiency in Python programming language.


Experience with NLP techniques and LLMs.


Excellent understanding of prompt engineering principles and practices.


Ability to work with large datasets and develop scalable solutions.


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Excellent communication and collaboration skills.




About Company



NEXGILE TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED is a leading company in the industry, committed to delivering high-quality products and services.
